requirements.statement: /create-trd <prd> --design docs/ui/<slug> --boards <ids> builds and approves exactly the named boards, using the same rules /plan --design --boards uses. Must-pass.
/create-design keeps item ids from its source (e.g. S1, S2) and assigns BI-n only when the source has none.
Each board in design-map.json records brief_items; written by /create-design, kept current by /refine-design; design-map.js validate accepts the field. Must-pass, unconfirmed.
design-map.js buildable --items returns buildable to-be boards whose brief_items include a named item; an item no board serves is reported, not dropped. Must-pass, unconfirmed.
/audit-design traceability reads brief_items from the map, so no-brief-item and no-board findings come from the recorded field.
Under --auto, /create-design and /refine-design still produce open decisions and record each under '## Decisions taken by default' with an OD-n id. Must-pass, unconfirmed.
/refine-design <slug> --auto 'OD-2: <option>' applies an answer, redraws affected boards, and records the answer in brief.md.
/refine-design --auto with no other feedback takes open findings from the latest audit-design-report.md as feedback.
/audit-build and /close-feature word the /sync-design NEXT step so running it before merge on the feature branch is allowed; /sync-design states it may run on a feature branch.
No shipped text names a particular product or orchestrator; wording is for any unattended caller.
End-to-end walk of the multi-feature path in a scaffolded react-web fixture copy is live-proven.
audit-build and close-feature name /sync-design <slug> --trd <trd-path> for the unsynced-boards step.
/create-design: resolve, ground, brief, as-is, parts, to-be, challenge, publish (PRD design-stage.md AC-F8). Scope references only; this TRD is for the investigation, not the PRD.
/refine-design: adopt edits, feedback sources, targeted changes, owner-only approval, modes, main session (PRD AC-F9).
/audit-design: report, Could Not Verify, board-and-line findings, refuting file (PRD AC-F10).
No mid-run pause outside the four cases; --auto asks nothing (PRD NFR-4).

open_questions: OQ-1: Should --auto cap open decisions at four? Assumed no cap (TRD states this). If wrong, change the AUTO branch in DORCH-B002.
OQ-2: Is a bad OD-n reference STUCK or an ISSUES line? Assumed ISSUES line; run continues.
OQ-3: Should shipped_commit be re-pointed after a feature-branch merge? Assumed no, out of scope (TR1).
OQ-4: Should the board side of traceability cover part, as-is and flow boards? Assumed to-be boards only.
OQ-5: Should concurrent features coordinate writes to one design-map.json? Assumed not addressed (TR2).
OQ-6: What counts as a weak default? Assumed the brief agent's own weak flag (D7).
OQ-7: Which audit report lines count as open findings? Assumed every finding line except rejected findings, CAVEAT and Could Not Verify (D10).
Owner must confirm must-pass marks on O3, O4 and O6, which the investigation marked without a stated reason (TRD Objectives note).

The Index agent copies brief item ids exactly, and to-be draw agents return a correct brief_items field. Check: live /audit-design run and reading the map (DORCH-T001).
No caller outside create-trd.md and plan.md parses buildable CLI output. Check: grep consuming projects; this repo was grepped, consuming projects are outside it.
O1 and O6 rest on prose tests in a normal run; live proof (DORCH-T001) is deferred by design. Check: run DORCH-T001.
A board moved to shipped on a feature branch keeps its shipped_commit after merge only with a merge commit; squash merge rewrites the sha. Check: merge one pre-merge-synced PR each way (TR1, OQ-3).
